normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is non-normative and absent from every draft cell.

source_native_implementation.interface: normal rendered whole-platform Springer Nature Link search
source_native_implementation.query_syntax: Springer Nature Link Keywords query syntax
source_native_implementation.query_field: Link Keywords (title, abstract, and body text; not supplementary files)
source_native_implementation.boolean_form: fully parenthesized uppercase AND/OR groups passed unchanged as the query parameter
source_native_implementation.phrase_policy: Every multiword dictionary entry remains one ordered quoted phrase; punctuation and hyphen normalization remain untested.
source_native_implementation.acronym_policy: Acronyms remain quoted literals; standalone-token behavior remains untested.

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Unordered pair in one searchable field with at most five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_transport: Pair-bearing concepts are rendered as exhaustive left/right Boolean conjunction cross-products in the Link Keywords field, preserving every dictionary literal but not claiming proximity equivalence.
paired_term_handling.why: No current Springer-native proximity syntax or same-field distance behavior has been observed source-free or live. Do not treat broad Boolean co-occurrence as an accepted pair implementation.
paired_term_handling.future_gate: Validate a source-native unordered <=5-intervening-token operator or a documented broader same-field construction that cannot lose an exact pair; apply the exact rule locally wherever retained fields permit.

controls.source_boundary: Full Springer Nature Link platform; no content-type, access, subject, brand, venue, or supplementary-file facet.

date.upper_bound_status: diagnostic only; P-001 remains unresolved and this is not a final cutoff
date.exact_day_mode: --date-start/--date-end are required only for strict complete mode; local exact-day validation is adapter-enforced.

controlled_vocabulary.reason: The current Link Keywords adapter exposes no validated thesaurus, hierarchy, narrower-term, explosion, or distinct indexed-term route in its offline contract; live source inspection remains required.
controlled_vocabulary.mandatory_rule: Free text remains mandatory. No generic systems-engineering descriptor may substitute for M_H; any future validated descriptor can only OR-supplement its mapped free-text block.

query_length_and_cell_policy.basis: untested_source_limit; local adapter only rejects empty/wildcard-only queries
query_length_and_cell_policy.current_cells: One complete v4 cell per required partition; no wildcard compression, narrowing, or semantic splitting.
query_length_and_cell_policy.lossless_shards: Not required by any observed limit; create only after a live source limit and stable-identity union procedure are demonstrated.

lossless_union.rationale: The complete dictionary-v4 expression fits one draft Link Keywords cell; no source query-length limit or union identity behavior has been observed.

lossless_union_rule.identity: Stable canonical Link content paths must be retained and reconciled if any cell union is later required; this has not been observed.
lossless_union_rule.failure: Access, syntax, control, rewrite, total, range, page, identity, or completeness failure is total=null and imports no prefix.

retrieval_method.count_only: No cards or record pages are retained.
retrieval_method.diagnostic_retrieval: Rendered search cards, then only each exact canonical Link content route; abstract is retained when one visible abstract is exposed, otherwise abstract_not_available.
retrieval_method.stable_identity: Canonical same-host Link content path from the rendered result card.
retrieval_method.native_csv: Available only as an optional diagnostic normal UI export capped at 1000, with unpinned schema; rejected by --require-complete and never a strict-complete claim.
retrieval_method.strict_complete: Exactly two exhaustive ordered canonical-path passes, visible owned page, exact dates, and source total <=1000; pilot cap is narrower and predeclared in the execution plan.

partitions_note: All nine files are exact UTF-8 source-native Link Keywords drafts. They are not live observations and cannot support a final search until the required gates pass.
